correctness.rationale: Polynomial generating function poles: unique unit-disk pole z=1, no positive-real nontrivial poles; nondegenerate support forces at least one nontrivial pole. Dominant-pole coefficient extraction yields real finite trigonometric polynomial with mean zero and positive mean square, giving explicit positive lower-density sign bounds. The curvature multiplier (z-1)^2/z does not vanish on dominant poles, preserving mean-square positivity. Exponential error and positive renewal masses eventually follow from finite gcd-one support. Four exact-rational finite checks cover illustrative cases, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A positive-frequency obstruction to one-sided renewal-limit approximation and eventual uniform curvature behavior is substantially stronger than isolated reversals or mere failure of monotonicity. It applies to all positive probability weights and finite gcd-one support, including support missing 1. The exact pole-frequency mechanism supplies an intrinsic law-specific positive lower-density bound; not an arbitrary finite slice or known-table recomputation.
